notes: Granados wrote very little for violin. The list already covers the Sonata and the best-known arrangements, so the only clear omission is the Romanza for violin and piano. Other Danzas españolas and Goyescas arrangements exist, but I could not tie them to a named notable violinist with a firm edition, so I left them out.
